Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator instructed checking Vudu availability for “The Tenant” and “Nosferatu the Vampyre” without first applying the core constraint that the film must be under 2 hours. The IMDb page visible at Step 7 clearly shows “The Tenant” is 2h 6m, so it should have been excluded before any availability checks.
